motion.name: rule-draw

components.name: Send button
components.description: The only filled control. It sends the message.
components.css: .ds-send { font-family: "Schibsted Grotesk", Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 600; background: #414141; color: #f4f5f0; border: 1px solid #414141; border-radius: 0; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.65rem 1.05rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-send:hover { background: #2a2a2a; color: #f4f5f0; } .ds-send:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1b65c5; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-send:disabled { background: transparent; color: #414141; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Field
components.description: A labeled square field on the mint sheet.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.2rem; font-family: "Schibsted Grotesk", Helvetica, sans-serif; color: #414141; } .ds-field span { font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-field input { font: inherit; color: #414141; background: #f4f5f0; border: 1px solid #414141; border-radius: 0; padding: 0.55rem 0.65rem; caret-color: #414141; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1b65c5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Section index
components.description: The newspaper’s section names. The current one is underlined.
components.css: .ds-index { display: flex; gap: 1.15rem; font-family: "Schibsted Grotesk", Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 0.98rem; } .ds-index a { color: #414141; text-decoration: none; min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; } .ds-index a:hover, .ds-index a[aria-current="page"] { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.22em; } .ds-index a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1b65c5; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.northStar: The front page of a practice.
narrative.overview:
Bogdan Maftei’s site is one newspaper, not a stack of cards. The sheet is named for him. The lead is the appointment, Senior Technical Consultant, and the record of employers, projects, and skills continues in columns under hairline rules. The only filled control sends a message.

The day edition is mint paper read at a desk. The night edition is the same sheet with the ink reversed, chosen explicitly, not inherited from the operating system.
keyCharacteristics: A serif nameplate and headlines, a grotesque for everything a person has to read
Hairline rules that run through the sheet, including one vertical rule through the engagements
Coral used once, as the flag on the current role
Square corners, no shadow, no gradient
Body copy held to a readable measure

rules.name: The Ink Rule
rules.body: Gunmetal carries the reading. Coral is a status mark, never a decoration, a link, or a second button.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Source Serif 4, weight 600, sets the nameplate, the lead, section titles, roles, and project titles. Schibsted Grotesk sets navigation, body, labels, dates, and the send button. Italic Source Serif 4, weight 400, is reserved for the portrait caption.

rules.name: The Sheet Rule
rules.body: Content lives in one centered sheet, min(68rem, calc(100% - 1.5rem)), widening its side margin from 900px. The nameplate spans the sheet. A double rule sits under it: a 1px line and a 3px line. The dateline holds the date, the section index, and the edition control, closed by a 1px rule.

rules.name: The One Motion Rule
rules.body: The masthead double rule draws once from the center, 720ms, with an ease-out. Reduced motion removes it. Nothing else enters, fades, or hides until scroll.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: The page has no drop shadow and no blur. Depth is the difference between sheet and the white Write box, plus the weight of the rules. The logo plate is a flat black field, not a raised tile.

rules.name: The Square Rule
rules.body: Corners are 0. Buttons, fields, the Write box, the Present flag, and the logo plate are rectangles. The portrait is a straight photograph with a caption rule, not a circle.

dos: Keep the biography, employers, dates, keypoints, skills, project descriptions, email, and links as recorded facts.
Put new reading on the same sheet: nameplate, double rule, dateline, then the story.
Use the serif for titles and the grotesque for sentences.
Keep coral on the Present flag.
Leave the send button as the only filled control.
donts: Don’t add a kicker above a heading.
Don’t turn engagements or projects into equal cards, circles, or icon tiles.
Don’t invent a promotion date, a client, or a metric.
Don’t put a second filled button beside Send message.
Don’t hide body copy until an animation or a scroll trigger fires.
